meta.name: alterlab-borzoi
meta.description: Predict genome-wide functional genomics tracks from DNA sequence with Borzoi (Linder 2025) — a sequence-to-function model outputting RNA-seq, CAGE, ATAC, and ChIP coverage across long context, used to score non-coding and regulatory variant effects. Use when predicting functional tracks from a DNA sequence, scoring a non-coding/regulatory variant's effect on expression or chromatin, or doing in-silico mutagenesis of a locus. To LOOK UP a variant's population frequency prefer alterlab-gnomad; for its clinical significance prefer alterlab-clinvar; for protein-structure effects prefer alterlab-alphafold; for single-cell foundation models prefer alterlab-scgpt. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 从DNA序列预测基因功能与调控变异效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究非编码区变异对基因表达或染色质的影响。
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene function and regulatory variant effects from DNA sequence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study how non-coding variants affect gene expression or chromatin.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的 DNA 序列，预测 RNA-seq、CAGE、ATAC 和 ChIP 等基因组功能图谱的覆盖度，并评估非编码变异对表达或染色质的影响。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 DNA 序列或基因组坐标，要求预测功能图谱、评估非编码变异效应，或进行原位诱变时触发。

say.text: 预测 chr1:100000-200000 区域的 RNA-seq 覆盖度。
say.note: Claude 会运行模型并返回预测的覆盖度数据。

say.text: 评估 rs123456 这个非编码变异对 ATAC-seq 信号的影响。
say.note: Claude 会比较参考和变异序列的预测结果。

say.text: 对 enhancer 区域进行原位诱变，找出关键碱基。
say.note: Claude 会系统突变每个碱基并分析预测变化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can predict genome-wide functional genomics tracks (RNA-seq, CAGE, ATAC, ChIP) from a DNA sequence, and score non-coding/regulatory variant effects on expression or chromatin.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a DNA sequence or genomic coordinates and ask to predict functional tracks, score a non-coding variant effect, or perform in-silico mutagenesis.

say_en.text: Predict RNA-seq coverage for region chr1:100000-200000.
say_en.note: Claude runs the model and returns predicted coverage.

say_en.text: Score the effect of non-coding variant rs123456 on ATAC-seq signal.
say_en.note: Claude compares reference and alternate predictions.

say_en.text: Perform in-silico mutagenesis on an enhancer to find key bases.
say_en.note: Claude systematically mutates each base and analyzes changes.
